text:
Ana (Sales): Heads-up: FinRegCo wants an EU-only POC. They need traffic & logs kept inside EU, BYOK, and egress IPs for whitelisting. Security board tomorrow.
FinRegCo - Alice: Yes — EU ingress/egress only, BYOK preferably Azure KV, subprocessors list, and single-IP egress ideal.
Jordan (SE): Short tech checklist: tenant pinning, subnet/NAT options, control-plane separation, model availability in eu-west-1. I can confirm models.
Maria (Ops): Tenant pinning for a short POC is possible. Note: disables cross-region fallback; autoscale within region still works. We don't do per-tenant static IPs by default. Options: 1) customer whitelists eu egress CIDR; 2) we provision a temporary dedicated NAT for the tenant (extra cost + setup).
Li (Legal): We'll need subprocessors list and confirmation logs/audit retention can be limited to EU. I can prepare a short attestation doc.
Jordan (SE): BYOK flow: customer provides key in their KMS (Azure/AWS), we reference the key via provider API, Redwood never sees plaintext. Example config snippet included in the note.
Maria (Ops): If customer wants single IP, temporary NAT setup ~ 1-2 business days and has a one-time setup charge. For a 2-week POC we can do a temporary allocation; estimate final by EOD after ops ticket.
deploy-bot: eu-west-1 capacity check: reserved pool available (2 nodes).
FinRegCo - Alice: Need the egress CIDR or single-IP and subprocessors attestation before EOD for security board. Also: what's rollback if residency fails?
Ana (Sales): Action items: Maria to get CIDR or NAT quote + open ops ticket; Jordan to provide BYOK + logs note; Li to draft attestation; Sales to deliver POC quote with two options by EOD.
Maria (Ops): Ticket OPS-7892 created for temp NAT. ETA for IP list: ~4 hours. One-time setup fee estimate ~ $500 (TBC).
Jordan (SE): BYOK + logging note posted to internal doc, will paste the snippet here after final check.
Li (Legal): I'll attach the attestation once infra confirms subprocessors list for eu-west.
FinRegCo - Alice: Also include time to revoke NAT and rotate keys after POC.
Maria (Ops): Revoke ~30 minutes of ops work. Key rotation depends on KMS but we can script rotation during POC window.
Ana (Sales): I'll send two-option quote: (A) POC - whitelist CIDR (no setup fee); (B) POC + dedicated NAT (setup fee + hourly while allocated).
FinRegCo - Alice: Perfect, thanks. Can you also provide a curl test for firewall validation?
Ana (Sales): Sure: curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <trial-key>" --resolve "api.redwood.ai:443:<egress-ip>"
Maria (Ops): Will post the exact CIDR/IPs in this thread when available.
Ana (Sales): Thanks team — aiming to close quote by EOD for security board. :thumbsup:
